references.text: Jesus gives a similar exhortation to watch and pray so that you do not fall into temptation.
Jesus urges the disciples to pray so that they do not fall into temptation, parallel with Mark 14:38.
David asks for a pure heart and a steadfast spirit, which can be seen as a prayer to resist temptation.
Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength, which can be interpreted as help to resist temptations.
Paul assures us that God will not let us be tempted beyond what we can bear.
